publications.title: A Padovan-automatic description of a nested recurrence
publications.authors: Benoit Cloitre, Haobo Ma, Wenlin Zhang
publications.summary: A finite-state description of the nested recurrence OEIS A076502 in the greedy Padovan numeration system. The paper proves the exact floor-offset set {−1, 0, 1, 2}, bounded discrepancy, and an explicit 26-letter morphic presentation of the first-difference word with least balance constant four.

publications.title: Sub-quorum colorings of graphs
publications.authors: Haobo Ma, Rafik Sahbi, Wenlin Zhang
publications.summary: Structural bounds, algorithms and exact values for partial vertex colorings in which each colored vertex has a weak majority of its colored closed neighborhood in its own color. Results include a linear-time algorithm on trees, NP-completeness on bipartite graphs, exact rectangular-grid values for every fixed width from two through eleven, and the hypercube identity ψsq(Qn) = β2(Qn) = 2^(n−1) for every n ≥ 2.
